_note: Round 58: how the game is sold (scripts/Store.gd, scripts/Ads.gd). Robert, 2026-10-05: 'free play up to level 5 on iOS and Android with a full pay option ... Steam has its pay version from the start, with promises of expansions' -- then, the same day: 'after level 5 ... it will be ads on the free tier, still able to complete the game, but every so often an ad will pop up; I don't want it to be too distracting, but I do want to be profitable.' So on phones (model "ads"): the village, the valley and floors 1-5 are free with NO ads; below floor 5 the whole game stays free to the end with an occasional ad at a natural break (taking the stairs down, reaching a town -- never in a fight, at most one every ten minutes), plus ads the player can choose to watch for a small gift. ONE purchase (the full game) removes every ad for good on that store account. model "locked" is the other way (below floor 5 needs the purchase) -- kept, switchable here. On Steam (and the box's own builds) the whole game, no ads, from the start. Product ids must match what's made in Play Console / App Store Connect; prices are set in the stores, never here.

style_pack.name: Dungeon Crawl Elite -- the Style pack (cosmetic auras)

pitch.title: The deep goes on
pitch.body:
Shellhaven is as far as the free road goes. Below it the stair keeps going -- forty-five more floors to the Heart of the Deep, every one with a reach of its own past its edge.

The full game opens all of it, once, for this device's store account:
  -  floors 6 to 50 and the ending
  -  the sects' roads to succession, the Jade Pagoda and the Hollow Moon
  -  major and heavenly inheritances, the deep's ten lands and their wardens
  -  every town below, every craft master, every art

Your character carries straight on -- nothing restarts. One purchase. No ads, no timers, and nothing you can buy makes you stronger.

expansions.name: East of the Hills
expansions.pitch: The road out of the valley, east past the hills Eliet has never crossed: an overland journey of sect cities, wandering cultivators and a war the deep has been waiting for.

expansions.name: Below the Heart
expansions.pitch: What lies under the fiftieth floor. The Heart of the Deep was a door; the expansion is what's behind it -- new realms past Immortal, and the ones who made the swarm.

expansions_note: Planned expansions -- not built yet. How one is made (DEV_GUIDE 'Adding an expansion'): its places are levels whose id starts with levels_prefix (e.g. levels/east_of_the_hills_road.json); its quests, items and words carry "expansion": "<id>". Set status to "released", steam_dlc to the DLC's Steam app id, and make the products in the phone stores. Store.owns_expansion(id) and Game.expansion_open(id) are what everything checks; Game.go_to refuses an expansion's places until it's owned and opens its window instead.

pitch_ads.title: The road goes on
pitch_ads.body:
Shellhaven is as far as the quiet road goes. Below it the stair keeps going -- forty-five more floors to the Heart of the Deep -- and all of it stays free, to the very end.

From here on there's a short ad now and then: only when you take the stairs down or reach a town, never in a fight, and never more than one every ten minutes. Sometimes you'll be offered a small gift for watching one -- that's always your choice.

Or make it yours for good: the full game removes every ad and adds comforts -- five character slots, an auto-stash, selling your spare gear in one go. Never power: nothing you can buy makes you stronger. Your character carries straight on either way.
pitch_ads.menu_body: The full game removes every ad, for good, on this store account -- the breaks at the stairs and the offers both -- and adds comforts (five character slots, auto-stash, sell spare gear in one go). Never power: the whole deep is already yours to play and nothing for sale makes you stronger.

steam._note: The Steam demo (export preset 'Windows (Steam Demo)', feature tag 'demo'): floors 1-5, then 'Get the full game on Steam'. It's its own free app on Steam (its app id goes in project.godot steam/app_id.demo); full_app_id is the full game's (it opens that store page). Both builds keep saves in the same folder on the PC, so the full game picks up the demo's character.

pitch_demo.title: The end of the demo
pitch_demo.body:
Shellhaven is as far as the demo goes. Below it the stair keeps going -- forty-five more floors to the Heart of the Deep, every one with a reach of its own past its edge, the sects' roads, the deep's ten lands and an ending.

The full game is on Steam. Your character is kept: install the full game on this PC and it picks up right here, on this save -- nothing to move, nothing restarts.

fair_play._note: Round 127 (Robert: 'pay for convenience but not pay to win'). tools/fair_check.gd fails the build if any of this stops being true.
fair_play.promise: Money buys convenience and style, never power. No purchase changes damage, health, qi, insight, drops, luck, prices or how fast you level.
